definitions.W1: Semantic answer selected by the original Baseline.
definitions.W2: Semantic answer selected by a fresh Baseline under the remapped presentation.
definitions.gap_reduction: Game W1-specific contrast minus Neutral W1-specific contrast; positive means the Game-Neutral W1-avoidance gap shrinks.
definitions.source_effect: Final-query source-line lesion minus natural within condition.
definitions.w1_specific_contrast: W1-line lesion effect minus the per-question mean effect of lesioning each of the other three repeated option lines.
